selection: fixed-seed uniform sample without replacement within each split, condition and ID
embedding: mean of BEATs_iter3 time frames, L2 normalized
anomaly_score: one minus maximum cosine similarity to normal training embeddings of same type and ID
qwen_prompt: Listen to this machine audio. Is there enough acoustic evidence to decide whether the machine sounds normal or anomalous? Answer with one of NORMAL, ANOMALOUS, or INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE, then give a brief reason based only on audible evidence. Do not infer the machine's exact fault or operating setting.
